parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is optional if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) temporary credentials.

parameters.name: localId
parameters.description: The local ID of the merge request, which is its sequence number within the repository.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can obtain the organization ID from the URL used to access Alibaba Cloud DevOps, such as `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The repository ID or full path.
